entries.translated: 将 Enter 键绑定到表格导航

entries.source: Requires restart of Obsidian. If enabled, when the cursor is in a table, enter advances to the next row. Disabling this can help avoid conflicting with tag or CJK autocompletion. If disabling, bind "Go to ..." in the Obsidian Hotkeys settings.
entries.translated: 需要重启 Obsidian。如果启用，当光标在表格中时，按 Enter 键将跳转到下一行。禁用此功能可以帮助避免与标签或 CJK 自动完成功能冲突。如果禁用，请在 Obsidian 热键设置中绑定“转到...”。
将 Tab 键绑定到表格导航

entries.source: Requires restart of Obsidian. If enabled, when the cursor is in a table, tab/shift+tab navigate between cells. Disabling this can help avoid conflicting with tag or CJK autocompletion. If disabling, bind "Go to ..." in the Obsidian Hotkeys settings.
entries.translated: 需要重启 Obsidian。如果启用，当光标在表格中时，tab/shift+tab 可以在单元格之间导航。禁用此功能可以帮助避免与标签或 CJK 自动补全冲突。如果禁用，请在 Obsidian 热键设置中绑定“转到...”。
使用空格填充单元格宽度

entries.source: If enabled, table cells will have spaces added to match the width of the longest cell in the column.
entries.translated: 如果启用，表格单元格将添加空格以匹配该列中最长单元格的宽度。
在侧边栏显示图标

entries.source: If enabled, a button which opens the table controls toolbar will be added to the Obsidian sidebar. The toolbar can also be opened with a Hotkey. Changes only take effect on reload.
entries.translated: 如果启用，将在 Obsidian 侧边栏添加一个按钮，用于打开表格控制工具栏。工具栏也可以通过快捷键打开。更改仅在重新加载时生效。

entries.source: If this plugin adds value for you and you would like to help support continued development, please use the buttons below:
entries.translated: 如果这个插件对您有帮助，并且您希望支持持续开发，请使用下面的按钮：
始终在新标签页中打开

entries.source: Open files in a new tab by default.
entries.translated: 默认在新标签页中打开文件。
防止重复标签页

entries.source: If a tab is already open, switch to it instead of re-opening it.
entries.translated: 如果一个标签已经打开，切换到它而不是重新打开它。

entries.source: Open in same tab on ctrl/middle click
entries.translated: 在同一标签页中使用 ctrl/中键点击打开

entries.source: When "Always open in new tab" is enabled, open in same tab when using Ctrl click or middle click.
entries.translated: 当启用“始终在新标签页中打开”时，使用 Ctrl 点击或中间点击时在同一标签页中打开。
聚焦显式新标签页

entries.source: Immediately switch to new tabs opened via middle or ctrl click instead of opening them in the background. New tabs created by regular click will always focus regardless.
entries.translated: 立即通过中键或ctrl点击切换到新打开的标签页，而不是在后台打开它们。通过常规点击创建的新标签页将始终获得焦点。
